releaseNotes:
v0.2.0 — Protocol resilience & diagnostics

Protocol & runtime
- Newline-split framer (replaces JSON-balance), retries reduced to 1
- Bump control-board ACK timeout to 2s; harden MotorBusyTracker
- Pause sensor polling while motor/BLDC commands are in flight
- Stop motor commands from racing after a lost ACK
- Pre-check water module ACK before waiting on dispense progress
- Recover dispense early if the final status frame is lost
- Route led.all replies in inferCtrl

Diagnostics
- LAN dev dashboard server with byte-exact Raw tab
- Surface water-module dispense in the dashboard
- Technician-facing error history with timestamp-anchored dedup

Behavior fixes
- Recover from cup-film retry when door is re-closed
- Honor RELAY_CLEANING_SPRAY default_ms during the cleaning cycle
- Route mix-step blade moves to the Y motor via hardware mapping
- Vary settings row icon color
- Stop BoundedNumericField from prepending its default after a clear
